title: VI-CuRL: Stabilizing Verifier-Independent Reinforcement Learning Reasoning via Confidence-Guided Variance Reduction
abstract: arXiv:2602.12579v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a dominant paradigm for enhancing Large Language Models (LLMs) reasoning, yet its reliance on external verifiers limits its scalability. Recent findings suggest that RLVR primarily functions by eliciting latent capabilities, motivating the development of verifier-free algorithms. However, in such settings, standard methods like Group Relative Policy Optimization face a critical challenge: destructive gradient variance that often leads to training collapse. translated_title: VI-CuRL：通过置信度引导的方差缩减稳定无验证器强化学习推理
translated_abstract: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已成为增强大型语言模型（LLM）推理能力的主流范式，但其对外部验证器的依赖限制了可扩展性。近期研究发现，RLVR主要是通过激发模型的潜在能力来发挥作用，这推动了无验证器算法的发展。然而，在此类设置中，诸如组相对策略优化（GRPO）等标准方法面临一个关键挑战：破坏性的梯度方差往往导致训练崩溃。为解决这一问题，我们提出了无验证器课程强化学习（VI-CuRL），该框架利用模型的内在置信度构建独立于外部验证器的课程。通过优先处理高置信度样本，VI-CuRL有效管理偏差-方差权衡，专门针对动作方差和问题方差的缩减进行优化。
tldr: 提出VI-CuRL框架，利用模型内在置信度构建课程并优先处理高置信度样本，有效降低梯度方差，从而解决无验证器强化学习推理中的训练崩溃问题。
en_tdlr: VI-CuRL stabilizes verifier-independent reinforcement learning reasoning by leveraging the model's intrinsic confidence to construct a curriculum that prioritizes high-confidence samples, effectively reducing destructive gradient variance and preventing training collapse.
